items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: The interviewee (Dick Sherman) does not mention Milt Fillius in his own turns. Milt Fillius is only mentioned by the interviewer in the context of the interviewer's own experiences and jokes.

ctx.x: Right, well just to wrap up, I’ve been always impressed by the loyalty and passion of Hamilton alums, the ones that don’t have it I haven’t met, so, you know, but the ones that I have, starting with Milt Fillius and I go what is it about this place that inspires that kind of loyalty.

It’s not one thing it’s a combination of things. There’s a beauty of the physical plant — you have the campus and Root Glen and things second to none. You have I think a marvelous faculty, in my day you did, and I think that we had a good administration, we had Winton Tolles. So the people who went to college in my day at Hamilton loved the college. They were enthusiastic then and as alums they become very enthusiastic. You’ll see them howling with delight when they hear our band playing.
